title: Give yourself where love can be trained
summary: This meets the self still trying to belong without surrender. The line says love deepens when body, fear, and doubt are handed to the Guru.
takeaway: Surrender enough to be trained in love.
lifeApplication: Before keeping part of yourself back, ask what you still refuse to give to the Guru. Offer one concrete attachment instead of another explanation.

source.shortMeaning: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve.
source.lifeApplication: When fear and doubt tighten, offer the withheld part instead of defending it.

evidence.coreClaim: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve.
evidence.turn: Let surrender reach the body before the ego performs again.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before keeping part of yourself back, ask what you still refuse to give to the Guru. Offer one concrete attachment instead of another explanation.
